name: sih26100-monorepo
description: SIH26100 — AI-Powered Integrated Bid Compliance Verification & Seller Platform Monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:ai && npm run test:blockchain
scripts.test:ai: cd ai-service && python -c "import tests.test_engines as t1, tests.test_pipeline as t2, tests.test_seller_verification as t3; [getattr(m, f)() for m in (t1, t2, t3) for f in dir(m) if f.startswith('test_')]; print('ALL AI SERVICE TESTS PASSED')"
